messages:
Marco DeLuca: Hey team, Marco here  first day tomorrow. Quick blocker: SSO rejected my alias (m.deluca@redwood.ai). Need CRM seat, Dialpad number + mobile forwarding, Gong + onboarding playlists, AE playbook edit, demo org creds, and the latest competitor battlecards. Who handles what?
Lena Ortiz: Welcome Marco! Ill take CRM + battlecards. Which email alias do you want mapped?
Marco DeLuca: Use m.deluca@redwood.ai (that's my primary). Thanks.
Sam Rivers: Ill do Dialpad and forwarding. For mobile forwarding we need your mobile number and confirm SMS transcribe if you want voicemails in email.
Marco DeLuca: Mobile is +1-628-555-0142. SMS transcribe yes please.
Provisioning Bot: Ticket PRV-2555 created: CRM, Dialpad (forwarding), Gong + playbook perms, demo creds. ETA ~6 hours.
Lena Ortiz: Sent CRM invite and added you to "MM Pipeline - Assigned" saved view. If SSO still fails, try incognito and post the screenshot here. I gave view+comment for playbook and requested edit access.
Marco DeLuca: SSO still gives `403` when I click the CRM link. Screenshot coming.
Lena Ortiz: Re-sent SSO assertion and cleared group mapping. Try now.
Sam Rivers: Dialpad number assigned +1-415-555-0199 and forwarding set to your mobile. Voicemail->email + SMS transcribe enabled. Test by calling the number.
Marco DeLuca: Just called it, forwarded fine and voicemail hit my email. All good.
Aria Khan: Gong invite sent and playlist "AE-Ramp-Top-30" shared. Also uploaded a short Loom: https://loom.redwood.com/ae-ramp/intro-call (watch before your first shadow).
Marco DeLuca: Loom link 403 for me.
Aria Khan: Fixed link perms. Also added you to #ae-shadow and dropped the 1-pager battlecards path: Sales / Collateral / Battlecards / Q2_competitors.pdf.
Provisioning Bot: PRV-2555 update: CRM + Dialpad + Gong provisioned; playbook edit permission granted; demo org creds added to 1Password under Sales/Demos. Ticket closed.
Marco DeLuca: Everything working now. One last thing: where's the 10-minute discovery template? Want to practice before shadowing.
Sam Rivers: It's in the playbook under Call Scripts as `AE-Discovery-10m`. DM me and I'll pair-shadow your first call.
Marco DeLuca: Great, appreciate the help everyone. Ill post a follow-up after my first call. :handshake:
